description: Apps Script: add history-aware cell renderers to supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/Code.gs and branch writeDryerHourRow_ to use them, so an edited field cell shows the current value + its edit timestamp on top with newest-first `Previous: <v> / <ts>` lines beneath, rebuilt deterministically from the payload's hist array (replay-safe), updating the EXISTING sheet row in place with no new columns/rows and leaving unchanged cells untouched. Mirrors the FG-sieve stacked-cell pattern (FG_SIEVE_LINE_SEP='\n') and renders IST via renderFieldTs_. Reads the payload hist[]/ts/values produced by FEAT-002, so it comes after FEAT-002. Includes a self-contained .mjs unit harness. QC tabs, the Dryer '... - Form' tabs, and apps-script-thermopack are untouched (C7).
steps: Read Code.gs around lines 1380 (DRYER_V2_HOURLY_COLS), 1641 (renderDryerMaintenance_), 1659 (dryerCellWithTs_), 1714 (writeDryerHourRow_), 3095 (coalesce_), 3164 (renderFieldTs_) and 208 (FG_SIEVE_LINE_SEP) to match existing style.

Add function dryerCellWithHistory_(hist) for SCALAR fields: hist = [{v,ts},...] oldest-first; render NEWEST-FIRST as line1 = coalesce_(cur.v), line2 = renderFieldTs_('qc_fg', cur.ts) where cur = hist[hist.length-1], then for i from n-2 down to 0 push 'Previous: ' + coalesce_(hist[i].v) + ' / ' + renderFieldTs_('qc_fg', hist[i].ts); return lines.join(FG_SIEVE_LINE_SEP). A cleared current value renders a blank top line + its edit time via coalesce_(cur.v) (design 3.2/3.3).

Add function dryerMaintCellWithHistory_(hist) for the MAINTENANCE object field: hist = [{v:{shifter_screen,atomizer_water}, ts},...] oldest-first; the newest entry renders via renderDryerMaintenance_(cur.v) VERBATIM (may be multi-line, each selected option with its own per-option IST time from the object's ISO - C6); if that is '' emit no current line; each prior entry renders as a SINGLE 'Previous: ' line with the object's internal newlines collapsed to ' ; ', and a prior all-deselected state (renderDryerMaintenance_ returns '') renders as the literal 'Previous: (none)' (design 3.3). Join with FG_SIEVE_LINE_SEP.

In writeDryerHourRow_, for each DRYER_V2_HOURLY_COLS field fk put the p.hist[fk] presence test FIRST, BEFORE the existing vals[fk] non-empty test (design 3.2 load-bearing ordering, so a cleared field is rewritten from history instead of leaving the stale value). For fk==='maintenance': if p.hist && Array.isArray(p.hist.maintenance) && p.hist.maintenance.length -> out[3+c]=dryerMaintCellWithHistory_(p.hist.maintenance); else keep the existing single-object branch (renderDryerMaintenance_(vals[fk]), only set when non-empty). For a scalar fk: if p.hist && Array.isArray(p.hist[fk]) && p.hist[fk].length -> out[3+c]=dryerCellWithHistory_(p.hist[fk]); else if vals[fk] present and non-empty -> existing dryerCellWithTs_(vals[fk], ts[fk]); else leave the cell as read (unchanged cell untouched - C3).

Defensive fallback: if p.hist[fk] is present but not a non-empty array, fall through to the existing dryerCellWithTs_/renderDryerMaintenance_ path (never throw, never lose the current value) (design 10). Keep in-place matching by H|date|shift|hour (dryerFindRow_), the single setValues write, and add NO headers/columns/rows (C4,C5). Do not touch QC writers or thermopack.

Add supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/dryer_cell_history.test.mjs following the self-contained pattern of dryer_row_identity.test.mjs (plain assert, process.exit(1) on failure; MIRROR the renderer + a minimal renderFieldTs_ IST stub, do NOT import Code.gs). Cover: determinism/replay (same hist -> same string); newest-first three-edit ordering (design 3.3 example: 190 / 10:15:30 / Previous: 185 / 09:20:15 / Previous: 180 / 08:05:10); cleared-field cell (blank top line + edit time + Previous line); maintenance multi-line current + collapsed Previous lines with per-option IST times; prior all-deselected -> 'Previous: (none)'; fallback to dryerCellWithTs_ when hist absent. Include comments mapping the isolated-environment Sheets checks to Acceptance Tests 2,3,4,6.
acceptance_criteria: writeDryerHourRow_ checks p.hist[fk]/p.hist.maintenance BEFORE the vals[fk] non-empty test, so a cleared-but-edited field is rewritten from history.
The renderers produce newest-first output joined by FG_SIEVE_LINE_SEP and use renderFieldTs_ (IST), never Apps Script execution time (C6).
No new Sheets headers/columns/rows; in-place match by H|date|shift|hour preserved; QC/Form/thermopack writers untouched.
`npm run build` still succeeds (Code.gs is not bundled, but confirm no other file was broken).
verification: Run `node supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/dryer_row_identity.test.mjs` to confirm the existing row-identity regression still passes.

ISOLATED ENVIRONMENT ONLY (N1 - record as a checklist in findings): with a non-production Spreadsheet + the pull/ack Edge Functions, confirm an edit rewrites only the changed cells in place (no appended/duplicate row), stacks Previous lines newest-first, preserves the original value/time, a replay produces identical cell content (no duplicated Previous lines), and QC + '... - Form' tabs are untouched.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Added dryerCellWithHistory_(hist) (scalar) and dryerMaintCellWithHistory_(hist) (maintenance object) to supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/Code.gs right after dryerCellWithTs_; both render newest-first, join with FG_SIEVE_LINE_SEP ('\n'), and use renderFieldTs_ (IST) never execution time (C6). Scalar cur=hist[n-1] -> value line + its edit time, then 'Previous: <v> / <ts>' lines n-2..0; a cleared current value yields a blank top line + edit time. Maintenance newest entry rendered VERBATIM via renderDryerMaintenance_ (multi-line, per-option IST), prior entries as a single 'Previous: ' line with internal newlines collapsed to ' ; ', prior all-deselected -> literal 'Previous: (none)'. writeDryerHourRow_ now tests p.hist[fk]/p.hist.maintenance (Array.isArray && length) BEFORE the vals[fk] non-empty test (design 3.2 load-bearing ordering) so a cleared-but-edited field is rewritten from history; a hist entry present but not a non-empty array falls through to the existing dryerCellWithTs_/renderDryerMaintenance_ path (never throws, never loses the current value); when neither hist nor vals present the cell is left as read (C3). No new headers/columns/rows; in-place match by H|date|shift|hour via dryerFindRow_ and the single setValues write preserved (C4,C5). QC/Form/thermopack writers untouched (C7). Added self-contained harness supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/dryer_cell_history.test.mjs (mirrors renderers + minimal IST renderFieldTs_ stub, does NOT import Code.gs).

VERIFIED (build): `node dryer_cell_history.test.mjs` exit 0 (15 assertions), `node dryer_row_identity.test.mjs` exit 0 (regression still green), `npm run build` exit 0 (Vite build succeeds; Code.gs not bundled, no other file broken).

ISOLATED-ENVIRONMENT SHEETS CHECKLIST (N1 - NOT runnable by the build; execute in FEAT-004 against a NON-production Spreadsheet + the pull/ack Edge Functions, never production):
[ ] AT2 - Save an hour, then edit one field: confirm the EXISTING row is updated in place (matched by H|date|shift|hour), only the changed cell(s) change, and NO appended/duplicate row is created.
[ ] AT3 - After multiple edits, the edited cell stacks newest-first: current value + IST edit time on top, 'Previous: <v> / <ts>' lines beneath in descending time order; the original value/time remains at the bottom (preserved permanently).
[ ] AT4 - Replay the same outbox event (ack/retry): the cell content is byte-identical, with NO duplicated Previous lines and no new row.
[ ] AT6 - All timestamps shown are the field's own IST edit time (Asia/Kolkata, hh:mm:ss AM/PM), never the Apps Script execution time; maintenance shows per-option IST times.
[ ] Maintenance cell: current selection renders verbatim multi-line; prior edits collapse to single 'Previous: ... ; ...' lines; a prior all-deselected state shows 'Previous: (none)'; a cleared current selection emits no current line.
[ ] Cleared-but-edited scalar field: the cell shows a blank top line + its edit time + Previous lines (not the stale old value).
[ ] QC tabs and the Dryer '... - Form' tabs are untouched (no new columns/rows, no reformatting) (C7).
